answer: In an agent marketplace, each identity must lock $100 for 30 days to earn a quota of ten bids per hour. Agents surveying a canyon, mapping a reef, or forecasting a gale face the same rule. Creating extra identities grants no free bidding power: an attacker seeking 10,000 bids per hour must fund 1,000 bonds, tying up $100,000 for a month. The defense makes influence scale with committed capital, so cheap account creation cannot multiply it.
